theorem RInv_propose {dec : CCDec} {c0 : CCState} {r : RState} (id : w64) (m : Msg) (cs : List
    (Option ConfChangeIM)) (ms : List Msg) (H : RInv dec c0 r) (hrole : r.p.role = Role.leader) (hcs

    cs).snd, snap := r.snap, cidx := r.cidx, cfg := r.cfg, fp := r.fp }

def LogMatchL (F G : List EntryM) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : Nat) (e e' : EntryM),
    F[k]? = some e → G[k]? = some e' → e.Term' = e'.Term' → List.take (k + 1) F = List.take (k + 1) G

theorem NoUndecConfIn.prefix {dec : CCDec} {l l' : List EntryM} {lo hi : Nat} (hp : l <+: l') (hh :
    hi ≤ l.length) (h : NoUndecConfIn dec l lo hi) : NoUndecConfIn dec l' lo hi

    r.fp) (hb : r'.p.base = r.p.base) (hl : r'.p.log = r.p.log) (hc : r'.p.commit = r.p.commit) (ha
    : r'.applied = r.applied) (hs : r'.snap = r.snap) (hci : r'.cidx = r.cidx) (hcf : r'.cfg =
    r.cfg) (hrole : r'.p.role = Role.follower ∨ r'.p.role = r.p.role ∧ r'.pci = r.pci) : RInv dec c0
    r'

theorem RInv_appAccept {dec : CCDec} {c0 : CCState} {r : RState} (m : Msg) (lastnewi : w64) (es' :
    List EntryM) (ms : List Msg) (H : RInv dec c0 r) (hma : plogMaybeAppend r.p.base r.p.log { term'
    := m.logterm, index' := m.index } m.entries = some (lastnewi, es')) (hcf : plogFindConflict
    r.p.base r.p.log m.entries = W64 0 ∨ uint.Z r.p.commit < uint.Z (plogFindConflict r.p.base
    r.p.log m.entries)) (hk : AppKnow r m) : RInv dec c0 { p :=
        psendMsgs
          (have __src := padoptLeader r.p m.src;
          { term := __src.term, vote := __src.vote, lead := __src.lead, role := __src.role, votes := __src.votes,
            outbox := __src.outbox, base := __src.base, log := es',
            commit := plogCommitTo r.p.commit (if uint.Z m.commit < uint.Z lastnewi then m.commit else lastnewi),
            matched := __src.matched, rd := __src.rd })
          ms,
      applied := r.applied, pci := r.pci, snap := r.snap, cidx := r.cidx, cfg := r.cfg, fp := r.fp }

theorem propConfStep_inv (joint : Bool) {applied li pci : w64} {acc : List EntryM × w64} {x : EntryM
    × Option ConfChangeIM} (h : PCInv applied li pci acc) (hx : x.snd.isSome = decide (IsConfEnt
    x.fst)) (hal : uint.Z applied ≤ uint.Z li) (hb : uint.Z li + ↑acc.fst.length + 1 < 2 ^ 64) :
    PCInv applied li pci (propConfStep joint applied li acc x)

def ConfI3 (l : List EntryM) (pci a : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ (k : Nat) (e : EntryM), l[k]? = some e → IsConfEnt e → k < pci) ∧ confCount (List.drop a l) ≤ 1

    ¬IsConfEnt e) : confCount l = 0

    Msg) (H : RInv dec c0 r) (hrole : r.p.role = Role.candidate) (hlast : plogLastIndexZ r.p.base

theorem RInv_keep {dec : CCDec} {c0 : CCState} {r : RState} (p' : PState) (H : RInv dec c0 r) (hb :
    p'.base = r.p.base) (hl : p'.log = r.p.log) (hc : p'.commit = r.p.commit) (hrole : p'.role =

    snap := r.snap, cidx := r.cidx, cfg := r.cfg, fp := r.fp }

def AppKnow (r : RState) (m : Msg) : Prop :=
  AppPayloadOk m ∧
    ∃ G,
      G.length = uint.nat m.index + m.entries.length ∧
        List.drop (uint.nat m.index) G = m.entries ∧
          ConfI1 G (uint.nat m.commit) ∧
            (0 < uint.nat m.index → ∃ e, G[uint.nat m.index - 1]? = some e ∧ e.Term' = m.logterm) ∧ LogMatchL r.full G

theorem NoUndecConfIn.of_prefix {dec : CCDec} {l l' : List EntryM} {lo hi : Nat} (hp : l <+: l') (hh
    : hi ≤ l.length) (h : NoUndecConfIn dec l' lo hi) : NoUndecConfIn dec l lo hi

    = r.fp) (hb : r'.p.base = r.p.base) (hl : r'.p.log = r.p.log) (hc : uint.Z r.p.commit ≤ uint.Z
    r'.p.commit) (hcl : uint.Z r'.p.commit ≤ plogLastIndexZ r'.p.base r'.p.log) (ha : r'.applied =
    r.applied) (hs : r'.snap = r.snap) (hci : r'.cidx = r.cidx) (hcf : r'.cfg = r.cfg) (hrole :
    r'.p.role = Role.follower ∨ r'.p.role = Role.leader ∧ r.p.role = Role.leader ∧ r'.pci = r.pci) :
    RInv dec c0 r'

theorem confCount_drop_zero {l : List EntryM} {a : Nat} (h : ∀ (k : Nat) (e : EntryM), l[k]? = some
    e → IsConfEnt e → k < a) : confCount (List.drop a l) = 0

theorem RInv_propose_ev2 {dec : CCDec} {c0 : CCState} {r : RState} {m : Msg} {cs : List (Option
    ConfChangeIM)} (H : RInv dec c0 r) (hrole : r.p.role = Role.leader) (hcs : CCTypesOk m.entries
    cs) (hlv : CCLeaveOk m.entries cs) (hnw : plogLastIndexZ r.p.base r.p.log + ↑m.entries.length <
    2 ^ 64) (k : Nat) (x : EntryM) (hk : (List.mapIdx (stamp r.p.term (plastIndex r.p)) (propBatch r
    m.entries cs).fst)[k]? = some x) (hx : x.Data' = [] ∧ x.Type' = W32 2) : r.cfg.cfg.joint = true
    ∧ cfgFold dec c0 (r.full ++ List.take k (List.mapIdx (stamp r.p.term (plastIndex r.p))
    (propBatch r m.entries cs).fst)) = some r.cfg

theorem preadRespondAll_fields (id : w64) (s : PState) (qs : List ReadReq) : (preadRespondAll id s
    qs).base = s.base ∧ (preadRespondAll id s qs).log = s.log ∧ (preadRespondAll id s qs).commit =
    s.commit ∧ (preadRespondAll id s qs).role = s.role

theorem propConf_foldl_inv (joint : Bool) {applied li pci : w64} (hal : uint.Z applied ≤ uint.Z li)
    (xs : List (EntryM × Option ConfChangeIM)) (hx : ∀ (x : EntryM × Option ConfChangeIM), x ∈ xs →
    x.snd.isSome = decide (IsConfEnt x.fst)) (acc : List EntryM × w64) : PCInv applied li pci acc →
    uint.Z li + ↑acc.fst.length + ↑xs.length < 2 ^ 64 → PCInv applied li pci (List.foldl
    (propConfStep joint applied li) acc xs)

theorem propConf_inv (joint : Bool) {applied li pci : w64} {ents : List EntryM} {cs : List (Option
    ConfChangeIM)} (hcs : CCTypesOk ents cs) (hal : uint.Z applied ≤ uint.Z li) (hnw : uint.Z li +
    ↑ents.length < 2 ^ 64) : PCInv applied li pci (propConf applied li pci ents cs joint)

theorem ConfI1.mono {l : List EntryM} {c c' : Nat} (h : ConfI1 l c) (hc : c ≤ c') : ConfI1 l c'

theorem propConf_foldl_leave (joint : Bool) {applied li : w64} (xs : List (EntryM × Option
    ConfChangeIM)) (hx : ∀ (x : EntryM × Option ConfChangeIM), x ∈ xs → x.snd.isSome = decide
    (IsConfEnt x.fst)) (hl : ∀ (x : EntryM × Option ConfChangeIM), x ∈ xs → x.fst.Data' = [] →
    x.fst.Type' = W32 2 → ∀ (c : ConfChangeIM), x.snd = some c → ccWantsLeave c = true) (acc : List
    EntryM × w64) : (∀ (y : EntryM), y ∈ acc.fst → y.Data' = [] → y.Type' = W32 2 → joint = true) →
    ∀ (y : EntryM), y ∈ (List.foldl (propConfStep joint applied li) acc xs).fst → y.Data' = [] →
    y.Type' = W32 2 → joint = true

def PCInv (applied li pci : w64) (acc : List EntryM × w64) : Prop :=
  uint.Z pci ≤ uint.Z acc.snd ∧
    (∀ (i : Nat) (e : EntryM), acc.fst[i]? = some e → IsConfEnt e → uint.Z li + ↑i + 1 ≤ uint.Z acc.snd) ∧
      confCount acc.fst ≤ 1 ∧
        (confCount acc.fst = 0 → acc.snd = pci) ∧
          (0 < confCount acc.fst → uint.Z pci ≤ uint.Z applied ∧ uint.Z applied < uint.Z acc.snd)

theorem RInv_snapFastfwd {dec : CCDec} {c0 : CCState} {r : RState} (m : Msg) (ms : List Msg) (H :
    RInv dec c0 r) (hc : uint.Z r.p.commit < uint.Z m.index) (hm : PlogMatches r.p.base r.p.log {
    term' := m.logterm, index' := m.index }) : RInv dec c0 { p :=
        psendMsgs
          (have __src := padoptLeader r.p m.src;
          { term := __src.term, vote := __src.vote, lead := __src.lead, role := __src.role, votes := __src.votes,
            outbox := __src.outbox, base := __src.base, log := __src.log, commit := m.index, matched := __src.matched,
            rd := __src.rd })
          ms,
      applied := r.applied, pci := r.pci, snap := r.snap, cidx := r.cidx, cfg := r.cfg, fp := r.fp }

theorem full_entry_of_term (F : List EntryM) (j t : w64) (h : plogTermAt base0 F j = some t) (hj : 0
    < uint.Z j) : ∃ e, F[uint.nat j - 1]? = some e ∧ e.Term' = t

structure RInv (dec : CCDec) (c0 : CCState) (r : RState) : Prop where
  full : FullOk r.p.base r.fp
  base_commit : uint.Z r.p.base.index' ≤ uint.Z r.p.commit
  commit_last : uint.Z r.p.commit ≤ plogLastIndexZ r.p.base r.p.log
  applied_cidx : uint.nat r.applied ≤ r.cidx
  cidx_commit : r.cidx ≤ uint.nat r.p.commit
  base_applied : uint.Z r.p.base.index' ≤ uint.Z r.applied
  lead_snap : r.snap = false
  cfg : cfgFold dec c0 (List.take r.cidx r.full) = some r.cfg
  i1 : ConfI1 r.full (uint.nat r.p.commit)
  i3 : ConfI3 r.full (uint.nat r.pci) (uint.nat r.applied)
  cand : r.snap = false ∧ NoConfIn r.full (uint.nat r.applied) (uint.nat r.p.commit)

theorem confCount_le_one {l : List EntryM} (h : ∀ (k1 k2 : Nat) (e1 e2 : EntryM), k1 < k2 → l[k1]? =
    some e1 → l[k2]? = some e2 → IsConfEnt e1 → IsConfEnt e2 → False) : confCount l ≤ 1

theorem cctypes_iff {ents : List EntryM} {cs : List (Option ConfChangeIM)} (H : CCTypesOk ents cs)
    (x : EntryM × Option ConfChangeIM) : x ∈ ents.zip cs → x.snd.isSome = decide (IsConfEnt x.fst)

    ↑r.full.length = plogLastIndexZ r.p.base r.p.log

theorem ConfI1.append_nonconf {l x : List EntryM} {c : Nat} (h : ConfI1 l c) (hx : ∀ (e : EntryM), e
    ∈ x → ¬IsConfEnt e) : ConfI1 (l ++ x) c

theorem plogFindConflict_first (b : entryID) (es ents : List EntryM) (d : Nat) (e : EntryM) :
    ents[d]? = some e → ¬PlogMatches b es (entId e) → (∀ (j : Nat) (e' : EntryM), j < d → ents[j]? =
    some e' → PlogMatches b es (entId e')) → plogFindConflict b es ents = e.Index'

    uint.Z r.applied ≤ uint.Z a) (h2 : uint.Z a ≤ uint.Z r.p.commit) (hn : NoUndecConfIn dec r.full
    r.cidx (uint.nat a)) : RInv dec c0 { p := r.p, applied := a, pci := r.pci, snap := r.snap, cidx

    (r1 : RState) (m : Msg), m ∈ ms → m.ty = MsgType.app → RInv dec c0 r1 → AppKnow r1 m) (H : RInv
    dec c0 r) : RInv dec c0 r'

    Role.candidate) : cfgFold dec c0 (List.take (uint.nat r.p.commit) r.full) = some r.cfg ∧
